texts.title_text: Germany grapples with drone threats, repatriation, and economic shifts
texts.slide_1_text: Germany faces growing drone attack threats, with officials preparing to name suspects in the Leipzig/Halle incident.
texts.slide_2_text: Interior Minister Dobrindt expands repatriation policy to include non-criminals, citing security and political pressures.
texts.slide_3_text: German carmakers face uncertainty due to Trump's fluctuating tariffs, impacting EU exports and trade relations.
texts.slide_4_text: Zelenskyy thanks Germany for military aid, as investigations into the drone attack continue.
